purpose: Forward response surrogate as the controlled subject of explanation-faithfulness and ADS-confirmed counterfactual experiments

primary_model.normalization: existing train-only input/output means and population standard deviations
primary_model.loss: Mean of per-region means of per-channel standardized Huber losses; four mutually exclusive regions weighted equally

regions_GHz.transition: Complement of the three regions on the fixed 601-point grid

primary_model.train_physical_constraint: none initially; record power consistency as a diagnostic, not as a proof of full passivity

limited_comparisons.name: frequency_Fourier_MLP_ablation
limited_comparisons.frequency_encoding: u=(f_Hz-9e9)/6e9; retain u and append sin(2*pi*k*u),cos(2*pi*k*u)
limited_comparisons.selection: Use only if validation improves RF-relevant errors without unacceptable oscillation; no assumption that encoding is beneficial

limited_comparisons.name: PCA_GPR_design_level_baseline
limited_comparisons.GP_kernel_candidate: ARD Matern nu=2.5 plus numerical jitter
requirements: Do not fit an exact GP to all frequency rows
Select rank and kernel settings on validation only

selection_rule: Freeze architecture and hyperparameters using validation RF metrics and repeated seeds; if both MLP variants meet goals and the composite validation score differs by less than 5%, prefer the unencoded MLP. This is an engineering tie-break, not a statistical significance claim.

provisional_validation_goals.status: engineering starting targets; not published standards and not measured results
provisional_validation_goals.failure_action: Improve the surrogate on validation; do not claim physics-valid explanations at poorly predicted frequencies. Any protocol revision must be recorded before final test evaluation.

explanation_interface.input_geometry_shape: N x 4 in physical mil units
explanation_interface.model_wrapping: Normalization, frequency conditioning, inverse output scaling, and RF scalar target remain in one differentiable function where needed
additional_targets: Fixed-mask violation with a recorded smooth approximation if used
explanation_interface.unreliable_target: Unique whole-filter f0/BW for the 36 multiband designs

SHAP.method: Exact Shapley coalition enumeration on four geometry features
SHAP.background_sensitivity_check: fixed 32 real training geometries selected before examining explanations
SHAP.exactness_scope: Chosen finite background and masking game; background averaging and causal interpretation are separate assumptions
checks: Intervention tests appropriate to the chosen game

IG.baseline: same physical geometry reference as primary SHAP

LIME.domain: explicit bounded geometry neighborhood; do not silently use out-of-domain default samples

do_not_assume: A faithful model explanation proves physical correctness
Attention weights alone establish an explanation

faithfulness_and_physics.model_faithfulness: Controlled network-input interventions and method-specific numerical/local-fit checks
faithfulness_and_physics.physics_consistency: Compare the same target and geometric perturbations using independent ADS circuit simulations
faithfulness_and_physics.local_perturbation_sizes: 1%, 2%, 5% of each declared feature span; use feasible one-sided perturbations near bounds and record actual steps
faithfulness_and_physics.sensitivity_caveat: Do not compare attribution values directly with derivatives without matching reference, perturbation semantics and units
faithfulness_and_physics.randomization: Additional model-dependence diagnostic, not sufficient by itself

counterfactual_experiment.objective: Reduce fixed specification-mask violation while penalizing normalized geometry changes
compare: Attribution top-k parameter search, k=1 or 2
Random-k parameter search with identical optimizer
ADS coordinate/finite-difference tuning under matched solver budget
counterfactual_experiment.case_selection: Predefine seeds and eligible failed-mask cases; do not cherry-pick successes after tuning
counterfactual_experiment.success: Confirmed by independent ADS simulation using exact fixed masks, never by surrogate prediction alone

test_policy: Existing whole-dataset integrity/coverage views are not model-selection evidence. Do not inspect test prediction errors until model/configuration freeze.
